newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Nokia 9-mth profit seen lower.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Nokia 9-mth profit seen lower.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 2.2 billion markka median forecast for telecommunications group Nokia Oy's January-September 1996 profit before tax and minorities.
Profit before tax and minorities EPS*
*EPS forecasts by 11 analysts of 19 in the survey.
Nokia's nine-month results are due for release on November 14 at around 1200/1000 GMT.
In January-September 1995 Nokia posted a 3.98 billion markka proforma profit before tax and minorities.

The analysts polled by Reuters forecast a full-year 1996 median profit of 3.75 billion markka (range 3.20-4.09 billion markka), and a median EPS of 9.4 markka (range 7.7-10.6 markka). (Full-year 1996 profit forecasts by 18 of the 19 respondents, full-year EPS forecasts by 16 of the surveyed).
Nokia's 1995 profit before tax and minorities was 4.93 billion markka.

Contributors to the survey were AG Securities, Aros, Alfred Berg, BZW Securities, Carnegie, Danske Bank, Enskilda, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FSB Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita, Morgan Stanley, Opstock, Paribas, Postipankki and Warburg Securities.
